column1: Bakusou Kyoudai Let's & Go!! is an official mobile game adaptation of the classic anime "Bakusou Kyoudai Let's & Go!!". We hope you enjoy it.
Our company has obtained official authorization from Tamiya to produce "Bakusou Kyoudai Let's & Go!!: Jetters" and distribute it in mainland China.

In order to regulate online game services, guide online game enterprises to put social benefits first, effectively curb the behavior of minors' addiction to online games and excessive consumption, the National News and Publishing Administration recently issued the "Notice on Preventing Minors from Addiction to Online Games".
The following are some of the contents of the notice:
Implement a real-name registration system for online game user accounts. All online game users must use valid identity information to register their game accounts. Online game enterprises must strictly and properly save and protect the real-name registration information provided by users, and may not use it for other purposes.
Online game enterprises can set up a visitor experience mode for their game services for no more than 1 hour. Users do not need to register with their real names and cannot deposit or make payments during the visitor experience mode.
Strictly control the duration and time period of minors' use of online games. From 22:00 to 8:00 the next day, online game enterprises may not provide game services to minors in any form. The total duration of game services provided by online game enterprises to minors per day shall not exceed 3 hours during statutory holidays, and shall not exceed 1.5 hours at other times.
Regulate the provision of paid services to minors. Online game enterprises must take effective measures to restrict minors from using paid services that are not consistent with their capacity for civil conduct. Online game enterprises may not provide game payment services to users under the age of 8. For users between the ages of 8 and under 16 provided by the same online game enterprise, the single top-up amount shall not exceed 50 RMB, and the monthly top-up amount shall not exceed 200 RMB; for users between the ages of 16 and under 18, the single top-up amount shall not exceed 100 RMB, and the monthly top-up amount shall not exceed 400 RMB.

New accessory merging instructions:
1.The materials required for crafting include accessories and synthesis materials. You can view them in the scheme description above
2.Material Acquisition: Chance from dismantling blue+ accessories or level drops

Notes on the disassembly of accessories
1.One-click disassembly can disassemble all blue and lower quality parts, with a selection limit of 50 parts at a time.2.One-click dismantling defaults to selecting from the first tab onwards
3.During dismantling, you can manually cancel unwanted accessories
4.Dismantling yields gold, and green or higher accessories may provide star-up materials, while blue vouchers or higher accessories may give specific synthesis materials.
5.When dismantling upgraded, enhanced, strengthened, or star-uped accessories, you will receive 60% of the materials back
6.When dismantling orange accessories, you get 10 4WD Gems, and from orange car shells, you get 20 4WD Gems. Collect enough gems to exchange for orange accessories in the Shop - Accessory Exchange Shop (excluding specially limited accessories)

9.Advanced and awakened accessories cannot be dismantled. You must revert them before dismantling

Notes on Awakening
1.Purple and above accessories can be awakened, after awakening accessories will get different bonuses

3.After obtaining a recipe, follow the same synthesis rules

Qualifying Rules
1.Each Qualifying season consists of multiple stages, with at least one stage requiring multiple Mini 4WD cars to complete.
2.Participants are ranked based on their completion times in each stage. If multiple participants have the same completion time, rankings are determined by the order of completion, with earlier completions ranked higher.
3.Each stage leaderboard displays points based on participant rankings. The total points from all stages contribute to the overall season leaderboard score.
4.Completing (winning) matches earns participants tier points. When tier points exceed the promotion threshold, participants advance to the next tier and receive corresponding rewards.
5.Participants at "Gold III" tier or higher will lose tier points for failing matches (e.g., incomplete races or disconnection exceeding 15 minutes). If tier points fall below the threshold, the participant’s tier will be reduced.
6.Tier rewards obtained in a season cannot be claimed again.
7.The overall leaderboard ranks participants based on their cumulative stage results and comprehensive statistics of stage completion times.8.At the end of the season, ranking rewards are distributed based on total season points.
9.The leaderboard does not update in real-time. Data updates may be delayed, so participants should take note.
10.There is no limit to the number of entries participants can make in each stage.
11.At the start of each new season, participants' tiers, stage rankings, and overall season points will be reset.

Track Editing Guidelines:
1.Each track must have one and only one lane changer.
2.The track must be closed to qualify as a valid track.
3.There is no limit on the number of track blocks, but the height and total area are restricted by the venue. Participants should plan accordingly.
4.If other track blocks cannot be used to complete the track and closure is impossible, a universal track block may be used to assist with closure.
5.If the track is not finished, participants can save their progress and continue editing next time.
6.The rotation button is only functional in top-down view. To switch perspectives, click the first "Free" button to change the viewpoint.

Event Challenge Instructions:
1.The initiator needs to consume a "Event Challenge Hosting Coupon".
2.Players who participate at the same time need to consume an "Event Challenge Participation Coupon".
3.The rewards will vary depending on the selected NPC difficulty.
4.The initiator will receive a reward of 20% of the total registration fee and the top three participants will receive generous rewards.

Description of Challenge Matches
1.The chapters of the Challenge Matches are released by the official.
2.There is a time limit to start the chapter, and you need to enter the challenge within the specified time.
3.During the activity period, players can only receive rewards once, and after receiving the rewards, they cannot challenge again.
4.When all the rewards of a chapter have been obtained or the valid time has passed, the chapter disappears.

Club Instructions:
1.The materials required for club construction can be obtained in club activities.
2.Players can sign in, complete club tasks, and refresh tasks randomly every day in the club. Different tasks have different rewards.
3.Sign-ins, tasks, and challenge attempts will be refreshed at 0:00 every day.
4.The club contribution earned by the player can increase the total contribution value of the club. When the contribution value reaches a certain level, the club can be upgraded. The higher the club level, the more items unlocked in the club store, and the member limit will also increase accordingly.
5.The player can Purchase items in the club store with personal contributions. If the player is not in the club, they cannot Purchase items.6.Note: It takes 24 hours to join a club after leaving.
7.More gameplay will be added in the future, please stay tuned.

Chassis: one of the necessary accessories for 4WD, which provides durability and suspension stats.
Tires: one of the necessary accessories for 4WD. The diameter and traction of the tires have different effects on different tracks.
Wheel: one of the necessary accessories for 4WD. Tires are installed on it.
Mass damper: It is mainly used to improve suspension capability.If the 4WD always rollover when landing,you can install this accessory to solve it.

Body shell: one of the necessary accessories for four-wheel drive vehicles. Different Body Shells have different styles and skills. Only by selecting the right Body Shell according to the characteristics of the track can we get a good ranking.
Front plate: this accessory is installed at the front of the 4WD, which provides the slot for the rollers and the mass damper.
Rear plate: this accessory is installed at the rear of the 4WD, which provides the slot for the rollers and mass damper.
Side stay: this accessory is installed in the middle of the 4WD, which provides a slot for the rollers. Some chassis does not provide the slot for side stay.
Conducting strip: mainly used to provide electricity saving effect, which has a greater effect on long-distance track
Transmission shaft: one of the accessories of the 4WD transmission system, which provides a large number of transmission efficiency values.
Axle: one of the accessories of 4WD transmission system, which reduces the RPM loss.
Motor gear: one of the accessories of 4WD transmission system, which reduces the torque loss.
axle Bearing: one of the accessories of 4WD transmission system, which plays a significant role in improving transmission efficiency and reducing the speed loss and torque loss.

Guide wheel: An accessory used to provide stability and reduce the friction between the four-wheel drive vehicle and the track wall. You can use a balance bar to install multi-layer guide wheels on the leading edge, phoenix tail, and center wing. Note: Installing too many guide wheels will also cause It will increase the friction of the guide wheel, please install it properly.
Pole: a connecting accessory used to install multi-layer rollers or mass damper on the front plate, side stay and rear plate.
Motor: one of the necessary accessories for 4WD, which is the power output accessory of 4WD
Gear: one of the necessary accessories for 4WD vehicles. It is used to transmit the power output by the motor to the wheels. Gear ratio is the most important stats of gears.

When durability reaches 0, the required Stability and Suspension attributes of the vehicle increase.

The 'Yellow Jump' track segment applies a debuff that reduces Stability and Suspension for 3 seconds. Each time the vehicle passes over a 'Yellow Jump', this debuff is applied. If the vehicle passes another 'Yellow Jump' while the debuff is active, a new instance of the debuff is added, stacking with the previous one—each debuff’s duration is tracked independently.
The 'Inclined Curve' track segment has a debuff effect that reduces the vehicle’s speed and torque. Each time the vehicle passes through an 'Inclined Curve', both speed and torque are reduced.

The 'Obtuse Corner' track segment has a debuff effect that reduces the vehicle’s RPM and torque by 50% for 2 seconds. Each time the vehicle passes through an 'Obtuse Corner', RPM and torque are reduced.

The 'Helix' track segment applies a debuff and has a minimum speed requirement. The debuff reduces the vehicle’s Stability by 500 for 5 seconds. If the vehicle passes through the 'Helix' multiple times within 5 seconds, only the duration is refreshed (no stacking). To successfully navigate the 'Helix', the vehicle must maintain a speed of at least 70 km/h. If the speed drops below 70 km/h while traversing the 'Helix', the vehicle will fall off the track, triggering the failure reason 'Dragon Drop'.

Car inspection introduction:
1. The car inspection function shows your car’s ability to cope with some difficult tracks
2. The car inspection function is a reference value calculated based on the basic attributes of your car
3. When calculating the car inspection function, your Body Shell skills and acceleration skills on the road to the competition are not included

5. The values calculated by the vehicle inspection function are for reference only
6. The vehicle inspection data is stored locally on the device, and the vehicle inspection records will not be saved after the device is replaced.

Now let me introduce the gameplay of the Golden League

The Golden League lasts for seven days. In the Golden League, players can choose tracks of different difficulty and opponents to compete (if it is not opened at this moment, please wait patiently for the next event to start)
Everything is possible in the game, don't worry about losing the game because the speed is not ideal, Your opponent may also overturn because of too fast speed

The winning rewards can be exchanged for rare items in the exchange mall. If the quantity is not enough, it doesn’t matter. You can wait until the next game starts and save enough your points to exchange.

Please click on the shell of the current vehicle.
Now let me introduce the shell inheritance gameplay.
Skill inheritance opens two additional skill slots for each shell. You can obtain a skill by consuming a shell accessory or some skill inheritance experience materials.
The acquired skills can be upgraded, and each upgrade can steadily improve the value.

When the skill reaches the maximum level, you can consume the skill recasting materials to recast the skill. The recasting is a percentage of randomness, and the attribute value obtained is equal to the maximum attribute of the recasting multiplied by the random percentage value.
Don't worry about changing the car shell. When you need to replace the skill, just click the replace button and select the appropriate skill and consume a certain amount of materials or car shell.
Skill books can be exchanged in the mall with ranking coins or challenge coins, or special event rewards. Pay more attention to activities.
